description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 30.08.2021 to 05.09.2021
categorisation: This gazette notification establishes new exchange rates for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It is a regulatory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs that modifies financial/compliance requirements, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter (Type 5) rather than a government personnel/structure notification.
